sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. UI health bar boss icon proposal for hand-painted 2D game Lanterns Underroot. Input1 is Hollow Sentinel identity model. Create ONE isolated centered AMBER faceted diamond-shaped chest crystal, matching the reference chest's golden-orange crystal exactly, with very small dark bluegray cracked stone socket rim around crystal. Icon should read clearly at64px. Square1024x1024 canvas, icon occupies central60percent, ample transparent margin. Warm cream-gold center, amber facets, subtle dark stone outline, no character body, no portrait, no health bar, letters, numerals, frame, text, square background, scenery, or additional icon. Genuine transparent background, crystal/stone interiors opaque. Minimal glow confined close to crystal; no broad haze. This is health bar icon only.
